name: @wenathlan/e2ugh-web
description: e2ugh web sandbox (grand-merge carrier): static console pages plus the self-hosted zero-dependency node api (web/server.js); static-first, no serverless functions
_comment: deploy manifest only: vercel and netlify require a package.json at the deploy root, so this file exists purely for static hosting configuration (see vercel.json / netlify.toml, no functions). this package is NEVER published to npm, github packages or any registry - the published package is the central @wenathlan/e2ugh (repository root) which ships the engine without web/. the start script exists only for self-hosted nodes (docker, vps, caddy) where web/server.js serves the same files and the /api/v1 contract. zero dependencies by design: node:* built-ins only.
